title: motif-faithfulness-audit: code, processed data and results of a stability and counterfactual audit of motif-level explanations in cell-conditioned multi-omics drug response prediction

creators.name: Abdelhaliem, Amr H.
creators.affiliation: Department of Cyber Security, Faculty of Science and Information Technology, Irbid National University, Irbid, Jordan

description: Reproducible pipeline, processed dataset (GDSC2 release 8.5 x DepMap 24Q2: 148,670 drug-cell pairs, 241 drugs, 704 cell lines, 1,141-gene panel), split indices and summary results of a stability and counterfactual audit of motif-level explanations produced by a CCMG-class (cell-conditioned motif graph) model for drug response prediction. Five motif-level explainers (attention, rollout, integrated gradients, masking, GNNExplainer-style masks) and four gene-level explainers are scored for seed, regime and input-noise stability, for faithfulness against input-space counterfactuals (motif deletion and swap, gene knockdown) and against drug-target biology, inside a DrEval-style protocol with naive and tree-ensemble baselines; attention-head, entropy and tuning controls, positive-control biomarkers, curated pharmacophores and a planted-importance sanity check are included. Raw DepMap and GDSC downloads are not redistributed (see README).
